value.rationale: The canonical disk model has a natural finite-level illumination functional introduced in 2026. The theorem determines all levels and endpoint geometry, reveals exact finite saturation and a quadratic terminal cusp beyond the known infinitesimal 2/3 law; the fixed level is not an arbitrary slice. This can calibrate more general ball-hull illumination and numeric constructions without overstating a general-body result.
